name: Constituent Services
description:
This dataset records constituent service cases handled on behalf of residents, likely by a New York City council office. Each row represents one case and includes a case ID, case type (such as Housing, NYCHA, Social Services, or Quality of Life), a more specific subtype and subject (for example, rent arrears, repairs, or security deposits), the case start date, an optional end date, and the case status (Closed, Pending, or Urgent). Rows also include the constituent's contact ID, city, state, and postal code, along with the responsible council member and community board. Most constituents are in New York (state code NY), and the most common case types are Housing and NYCHA. Many fields have missing values, particularly case end date, council member, community board, and postal code.

The data could be used to analyze the volume and mix of constituent requests by neighborhood, council district, or community board; to track how long cases take to close and what
